h1: Surf and Sand Resort — a small Khao Takiab resort where the rooms have their own kitchens and the beach is an easy walk away
intro: If you want a place in the Khao Takiab area that feels "more like a home than a hotel" — spacious rooms, a small in-room kitchen, a balcony where you can sit and watch the pool, and an owner who looks after guests like family — Surf and Sand Resort is a small resort that fits the bill perfectly · It sits on Takiab Road in Nong Kae, Hua Hin, just about 100m from the beach, near Wat Khao Takiab, and a few minutes' drive from Cicada Market · There are around 22 units across apartments, studios, and rooms, a pool with a jacuzzi, and it's pet-friendly · From about THB 1,100/night, scoring around 8.2 from real reviews on Agoda and Trip.com — it's not a luxury five-star resort, but a warm place that plenty of people grow fond of and come back to

body.html: Who Surf and Sand Resort suits — to put it as briefly as possible, Surf and Sand Resort is for people who want a sense of "home" more than the feel of a hotel · It's not a luxury beachfront resort with a sprawling lobby and dozens of staff, and it's not a chain hotel where everything is standardized the same way worldwide · Instead it's a small resort of around 22 units where the owner comes down to look after guests personally, set in the Khao Takiab area, which is quieter than central Hua Hin · From real reviews on Agoda, Trip.com, and TripAdvisor, the guests who say they love it most are those staying several nights, couples who want privacy, families who need a spacious room with a kitchen to cook in, and golfers who appreciate that the owner helps arrange rounds at nearby courses · Another group that comes up often is people who bring their pets along, because this is one of the few places in the Khao Takiab area that welcomes pets and has a back garden where they can roam · On the flip side, anyone looking for big-resort facilities — multiple restaurants, a gym, a full-service spa, and 24-hour service across every department — may find it too small and too simple · You could say Surf and Sand plays mainly on "warm and good value," in exchange for not having everything a large resort offers

Location and getting around — Surf and Sand Resort sits on Takiab Road in Nong Kae, the southern zone of Hua Hin known for its quiet and resort feel rather than the busier town side · The standout is that it's only about 100m from Khao Takiab beach, a few minutes' walk to the sand and sea · It's near Wat Khao Takiab (Wat Khao Krailat), about 400m away, a landmark with a standing Buddha by the sea and troops of monkeys to watch · Within less than a kilometre there are dozens of restaurants and seafood spots; international reviews rate this area's walkability at around 69 out of 100, which is decent for a resort zone · A little further out: Cicada Market and Hua Hin Sam Phan Nam Floating Market are about 1.8–2km away, a few minutes by car or taxi, while central Hua Hin and the night market are around a 10–15 min drive · Hua Hin Airport is about a 15–20 min drive, and if you're coming from Bangkok by car it takes roughly 3 hours · Worth noting: Takiab Road gets fairly busy on long weekends, and the resort isn't directly on the beach, so you do have to cross a small road to reach the water — but the distance is so short it's barely an issue

"Stayed six nights, the room was huge, had a kitchen to cook in, just a few minutes' walk to the beach, and the owner and staff treated us like relatives — fun to talk to, recommended restaurants and arranged transport for us. Next time we're in Hua Hin we'll be back here again."

Room types and decor — Surf and Sand Resort has around 22 units in total, split into several types that are more flexible than a typical hotel · The first group is the One Bedroom Apartment, with a separate living room and a small in-room kitchen, ideal for couples or small families who want the space · The second is the Deluxe Studio, many of which can connect into two-bedroom layouts, so groups of friends or larger families can book adjacent units and stay together easily · The third is the Deluxe Room in the secondary building, for people on shorter stays who don't need a kitchen · The point reviews agree on most is that the rooms are spacious and clean, the beds are comfortable, and almost every unit has a wide balcony overlooking the pool · Every room has air conditioning that cools well, a TV, a fridge, and crucially a small kitchen with the basics for anyone who wants to cook, which saves a lot on food during longer stays · The decor is a simple, warm-toned resort style — not luxurious but well kept · Some reviews note that the furniture and finishes in a few spots are starting to show their age with use, which is normal for a small resort that prioritizes value over being brand new · If pool views matter to you, or you want connecting rooms for the family, specify it at booking to get the unit you need

Facilities and the pool — the heart of Surf and Sand Resort is the outdoor pool with a jacuzzi corner at the center of the resort; most rooms face it, so it's easy to walk down for a swim · There's a separate kids' pool, which puts families with young children more at ease · There's also a game room for kids and adults wanting something to do in their downtime, plus a lounge area and back garden that many reviews say is great for walking pets · Basic services on offer include free Wi-Fi in the rooms and common areas, free private parking, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, and airport transfers (for an extra charge) · To be straight about it, the facilities here are "sized to the resort" — no large gym, full-service spa, or multiple pools like a five-star resort · But for people staying to relax quietly near the beach and cook in the kitchen, what's here is enough and well maintained for the price · The pool and common areas earn consistent praise for cleanliness

Food and bar — Surf and Sand Resort has a small in-house restaurant and bar serving both Thai and international dishes · One thing international reviews mention especially often is the tasty, well-made Indian food, which reflects the owner and team's personal touch · Breakfast is served roughly 8:00–11:30 AM for an extra charge separate from the room rate, with several options to choose from · That said, some reviews note that the breakfast options are fairly limited and simple compared with a big hotel's buffet · But this is where the location helps, because within walking and a short drive of the resort there are dozens of restaurants and seafood spots in the Khao Takiab area, so many people eat out instead · And the feature that sets this place apart from a typical hotel is the in-room kitchen, which lets guests buy ingredients at the market and cook for themselves — something longer-stay guests say is a real money-saver and very convenient · Overall, food isn't the reason to come here to eat in the resort, but a warm, flexible extra that suits using the resort as a base to explore the Khao Takiab area

Service — service is where Surf and Sand Resort earns its most concentrated praise in real reviews · Almost every review mentions an owner and staff who look after guests like family; the name that comes up often is the owner who comes by to say hello, suggests places to go, helps book restaurants, calls taxis, and arranges golf rounds at nearby courses for guests who love the game · This level of friendliness and attention is hard to find at a large chain hotel, and it's the main reason many guests come back · To be straight: because it's a small resort the team is small, so when it's full you may have to wait at times for things that need staff · But overall, service is a clear, distinctive strength here

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — gathered from Agoda, Trip.com, Booking.com, and TripAdvisor, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: rooms that are spacious and clean for the price, in-room kitchens to cook in, pool-view balconies, a location near Khao Takiab beach and Wat Khao Takiab, a clean pool with a jacuzzi, pet-friendly with a back garden, and above all a warm, friendly owner and staff that make many guests feel like they're staying at a friend's house · TripAdvisor ranks it around #9 out of roughly 45 places of the same type in Nong Kae · On the watch-out side: the points raised are that the breakfast options are fairly limited and simple, the price in some periods feels a touch high compared with nearby places in the same area, the furniture and finishes in a few spots are starting to show their age, and because it's a small resort it doesn't have as full a set of facilities as a large one · Most of these gripes are things you can manage by setting expectations right, rather than problems that keep people from returning — which is reflected in the fairly high share of guests who say they'll stay again

"Clean rooms, lovely pool, the owner is really sweet. The only downside is the breakfast options are a bit limited, but there are loads of good restaurants nearby and it's easy to walk out and eat. All in all, great value for the price."

Price and value — Surf and Sand Resort's starting price is around THB 1,100/night in normal periods for a base room or studio, climbing to roughly THB 1,800–2,800+ during high season, long weekends, or for the larger one-bedroom apartment · Compared with places of the same level in the Khao Takiab area, Surf and Sand feels good value especially for people staying longer and cooking in the kitchen, since you get a spacious room, an in-room kitchen, and a location near the beach · The thing to weigh up: if you compare purely on "price per night" against budget-only places in the same area, some may be a touch cheaper — which matches the part of the reviews that say the price is a little high · But once you factor in the room size, the kitchen, the jacuzzi pool, the pet-friendly policy, and the unusually warm service, many people conclude the money is well spent · The group that gets the most value is families and groups of friends who stay several nights and split the room cost

Good to know before booking — a few things make a stay go more smoothly · One, if you're coming as a family or group of friends, ask about the studios that connect into two bedrooms right at booking so you can be next to each other · Two, if you're staying long and want to cook, confirm you're getting a unit with a fully equipped kitchen, since the details differ by type · Three, breakfast costs extra and the options are limited, so if you like a full breakfast you may want to plan to eat at restaurants nearby · Four, if you're bringing a pet, notify the resort ahead to confirm the terms and a suitable room · Five, during Hua Hin's high season (November–February and long weekends) places in the Khao Takiab area fill fast and prices rise, so book ahead and compare across platforms · Six, choose free cancellation if your plans aren't firm yet, since prices tend to change with the season

Verdict — from all the real reviews, Surf and Sand Resort is the best fit for people who want a small, warm resort in the Khao Takiab area, with a spacious room, an in-room kitchen, the beach close by, and the kind of attentive, family-style service · The spacious rooms, the kitchen to cook in, the pool with a jacuzzi, the pet-friendly policy, and a location within walking distance of Khao Takiab beach and Wat Khao Takiab make it good value especially for those staying longer and coming as a family or group of friends · If you're after a five-star beachfront resort with multiple restaurants, a gym, and a full-service spa, or you want a full breakfast buffet, this may not be the answer, and you should look at the large beachfront resorts in Hua Hin instead · But for a quiet seaside getaway, in a place the owner runs with genuine care, and that's real value over several nights — Surf and Sand Resort answers that need nicely, and it's the reason many guests choose to come back

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Surf and Sand Resort Hua Hin

faq.q: Where is Surf and Sand Resort · what's within walking distance?
faq.a: The resort is on Takiab Road in Nong Kae, Hua Hin, in the Khao Takiab area · It's about 100m from Khao Takiab beach, a few minutes' walk, and near Wat Khao Takiab (Wat Khao Krailat), about 400m away · Cicada Market is around 1.8km, central Hua Hin is about a 10–15 min drive, and Hua Hin Airport is about 15–20 minutes away

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Surf and Sand Resort · do they have kitchens?
faq.a: There are around 22 units, split into one-bedroom apartments, studios, and hotel-style rooms · The studio and apartment units have a small in-room kitchen to cook in, and many rooms have a wide balcony overlooking the pool · Some studios connect into two bedrooms, ideal for families and groups of friends

faq.q: What's the starting price at Surf and Sand Resort?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 1,100/night for a base room or studio in normal periods · The larger one-bedroom apartment runs from about THB 1,900 up · During high season (Nov–Feb and long weekends) prices climb fast, so compare across platforms before booking

faq.q: Is Surf and Sand Resort pet-friendly?
faq.a: Yes · this is one of the places in the Khao Takiab area that welcomes pets and has a back garden for them to roam · We'd suggest notifying the resort ahead to confirm the terms and a room suitable for pets

faq.q: Who is Surf and Sand Resort for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples, families, and groups of friends who want a longer stay in the Khao Takiab area in a warm, friendly place — spacious rooms with a kitchen, near the beach, pet-friendly, and good value when you split the room cost · If you're after a five-star beachfront resort with full facilities, a large resort in Hua Hin may suit you better

faq.q: Does Surf and Sand Resort have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There's an outdoor pool with a jacuzzi and a kids' pool, kept clean, with most rooms facing the pool · Breakfast is served 8:00–11:30 AM for an extra charge and the options are fairly simple · Many people choose to eat at the dozens of restaurants around the Khao Takiab area
